program.name: Obserra Website and Academy Production Security Evidence
program.claimBoundary: Engineering alignment, release evidence, and audit traceability only. This ledger does not claim CMMC certification, CUI authorization, FedRAMP authorization, or FDACS approval.

framework.currentCmmcLevel2Crosswalk: NIST SP 800-171 Rev. 2 practice identifiers retained for the currently enforced DoD CMMC Level 2 assessment baseline.

records.title: Centralized Clerk runtime normalization and fail-closed identity
records.implementation: One server-side configuration authority normalizes Clerk's supported publishable-key environment names and surrounding whitespace, enforces matched live keys in Vercel production, initializes middleware before authentication, and emits only nonsecret reason codes when identity is unavailable.
records.boundary: Obserra application and Clerk external identity service
records.gap: Post-deployment runtime validation must confirm the production Clerk instance is actually healthy; provider assurance remains external evidence.

records.title: Canonical production domain binding
records.implementation: Vercel production aliases for both canonical Obserra domains are declared in source. Vercel assigns them only after a deployment is READY and targets production, preventing preview deployments from taking production traffic.
records.gap: Post-deployment evidence must prove both canonical domains resolve to the exact accepted production deployment.

records.title: Exact-SHA production release and runtime verification
records.implementation: The validated Gate 33 source was merged through PR 56, Vercel created a verified production deployment from the merge commit, and production routing/runtime are independently checked before release acceptance.
records.gap: Canonical alias promotion and final post-deployment runtime evidence are pending for the Gate 34 release.

records.title: Stripe payment authorization and signed fulfillment
records.implementation: Academy Checkout Session creation is POST-only and same-origin, purchase authorization is rechecked against the Academy control plane, fulfillment requires Stripe webhook signature validation and paid status, and deferred redemption revalidates the paid session plus verified Clerk email ownership.
records.boundary: Obserra application and Stripe external commerce service
records.gap: Stripe provider assurance and formal service responsibility evidence remain external.

records.title: Academy database least privilege and fail-closed publication
records.implementation: Academy learner/control tables use forced RLS with no anon/authenticated grants for backend-only data paths, public catalog access is GET-only and field-limited, missing control data fails closed, and only the reviewed nonregulated 60-course baseline is seeded as public/purchasable.
records.gap: Authoritative backup, restore, retention, RPO, RTO, and provider assurance evidence remain external.

records.title: CMMC Level 2 Rev. 3 no-drift traceability
records.implementation: The authoritative control register is machine-readable JSON, the audit matrix is generated from it, digests are verified in CI, and this release evidence supplement is likewise generated and checked from one machine-readable source.
records.gap: Formal organization policies, final SSP, CUI scope, and external assessment evidence remain separate requirements.

records.title: High availability, backup, restore, and failover evidence
records.implementation: Gate 31 requires candidate-bound cryptographic HA evidence rather than accepting availability claims without retained artifacts.
records.gap: Provider-backed availability, backup/restore, failover, RPO and RTO artifacts are not yet complete; Florida Class D production remains fail closed.

records.title: Regulated Class D separation from generic commerce
records.implementation: Generic Academy checkout, redemption, and Stripe fulfillment do not activate Florida Class D. Regulated mutations and production activation remain controlled by dedicated fail-closed authorities.
records.gap: Class D production still requires licensing, candidate-bound UAT, production database promotion, HA evidence, and explicit activation prerequisites.

records.title: GitHub protected-branch enforcement gap
records.implementation: The repository has governed PR workflows and exact-SHA validation, but direct control-plane inspection found the main branch unprotected and required status-check enforcement off. Gate 34 treats technical branch enforcement as an open control rather than equating voluntary workflow use with protected-branch change control.
records.gap: An authorized GitHub administrator must enable and retain evidence of a main-branch protection/ruleset that requires the governed pull-request path and mandatory release checks before this control is closed.
